name: NCCL issue 2428: NCCL_IGNORE_NET_MISMATCH turns a heterogeneous-HCA misconfiguration into a silent hang
notes: 2 nodes x 8x H20 over RoCE/eRDMA; rank 0 builds channels on an HCA rank 1 cannot open. Init completes then spins forever: SM 100%, memory throughput 0%, ~118 W of ~400 W, perf shows recvProxyProgress/_raw_spin_lock.
